chunks: If they find a shelter or caves or a place to hide, they will turn to it while they are rushing.

key_terms.مُدَّخَلًا: A place to enter or hide

ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers seek to do when facing divine punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah At-Tawbah underscores the psychological torment of the hypocrites and disbelievers who, despite their outward confidence, seek any available refuge—whether caves or hidden passages—to escape divine retribution. The term 'yajmaḥūn' (frantically rushing) highlights their chaotic state, contrasting with the tranquility of the faithful, and serves as a reminder of the inevitability of God's judgment for those who turn away from the truth.
